text:
Marco Silva: Morning team! I'm Marco (he/him) 0% excited to join eng-runtime as SRE. Quick list for day 1: Okta MFA seems stuck (push times out), building badge pickup, Datadog access, and who owns GPU quota requests. Fun fact: ran a 50k trail race last year. :mountain:
Karen M.: welcome Marco!!! :wave: For MFA try re-registering the device in Okta (Profile > Devices). If that doesn't work DM @IT Bot and cc me. Badge pickup is reception 9-5.
IT Bot: Automated: If Okta push fails, try the fallback TOTP code or re-register. Error code 502 indicates sync delay1 min then retry. If persistent, open ticket at it-support@redwood.com.
Marco Silva: tried re-register, still getting "push timed out" on iPhone 11. TOTP option not visible in the UI for me.
Evan L.: you can enable TOTP as a backup in Okta settings. Or use `okta-verify` app. If UI doesn't show, try incognito or clear cookies. If still nothing I'll kick this to IT.
Samir K.: cc'ing Platform leads for GPU quota. Marco, please open a request at https://redwood/internal/resource-requests and tag `gpu` and `priority:low|medium|high` with the expected vram and runtime. Typical turnaround 2-4 business days.
Marco Silva: opened request and tagged `gpu` with details (4x A100, 48h wall). Thanks.
Ana R.: Hey Marco 1 sending calendar invite for a 10m intro and I'll walk you through Slack channels, onboarding checklist, and how to get Datadog read access.
Marco Silva: thanks Ana! For Datadog do I request via the same equipment portal or a separate perms form?
Tess P.: Datadog is a perms form at https://redwood/internal/perms. Choose "Monitoring -> Read" for starters. If you need write/incident access ping me after you've got read access.
Marco Silva: got it. One more small dev question: where's the smoke test for the local runtime? I want to sanity-check my dev environment.
Evan L.: check gitlab.redwood/onboarding/runtime-smoke. Run `./scripts/smoke_test.sh` — it spins up a dockerized tiny model and runs a few prompts. If docker permission fails run `sudo usermod -aG docker $USER` and re-login. Also we prefer ed25519 SSH keys for Git.
Marco Silva: smoke tests ran fine after the relogin. SSH key added and `ssh -T git@github.com` passed. All green.
Karen M.: awesome. Team lunch is Wednesdays at noon in the cafe (this week's theme: tacos). You're welcome to join. :taco:
Marco Silva: tacos sound perfect. I'm allergic to shellfish so no worries there. Thanks everyone for the quick help!
(Reaction summary: Karen M. :tada: on intro, Ana R. :wave:, Evan L. :thumbsup:)
